tools.name: search_journals
tools.description: Search 46,000+ academic journals by title, ISSN, or publisher. Returns indexing status (WoS/Scopus/DOAJ), SJR quartile, trust score, APC and open-access info per journal. Supports filters.

tools.name: get_journal
tools.description: Full profile of one journal by ISSN: indexing, quartile, trust score with breakdown, APC, open-access status, scope, and integrity signals (e.g. DOAJ withdrawal). Use when the user asks about a specific journal.

tools.name: compare_journals
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2-4 journals by ISSN: trust, quartile, indexing, APC.

tools.name: check_citations
tools.description: Verify a pasted reference list (plain text, BibTeX or RIS) against Crossref, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar and arXiv. Flags references that cannot be found (possibly fabricated/hallucinated), retracted papers, and DOI mismatches. Free, no signup.
